question: Answer in short bullet points, "unknown" if unsure. (1) CAPTIONS: font style, size relative to frame, vertical position, words per screen, case, outline; which words (if any) get a different colour or size and WHY (the number, the conflict word, a name, or random); does any caption pop or animate in? (2) FIRST 2 SECONDS: what is on screen in frame 1, what is the first spoken line, is there movement, is text on screen. (3) VOICE: pace (fast/medium/slow), pauses between sentences, emphasis changes. (4) SFX: list each sound effect type (whoosh, hit, riser, pop...) and approximately when. (5) MUSIC: genre, volume vs voice, any drop before the payoff. (6) VISUAL DEVICES: zoom/punch-ins, speed ramps, freeze frames, circles/arrows, split screens; how many cuts per 10 seconds. (7) LAST 2 SECONDS: what happens and does it loop to the start.
answer:
Here is the breakdown of the video based on your requested criteria:

* **(1) CAPTIONS**
  * **Font style:** Heavy bold, sans-serif.
  * **Size:** Medium (occupies ~20–30% of screen width).
  * **Vertical position:** Lower-middle center.
  * **Words per screen:** 2 to 4 words per line.
  * **Case:** ALL CAPS.
  * **Outline:** Black outline around white text.
  * **Color changes:** On-screen score counters change color (yellow to bright green) to highlight escalating point totals and emphasize the central competition.
  * **Animation:** Pop-in synchronized chunk-by-chunk with the voiceover.

* **(2) FIRST 2 SECONDS**
  * **Frame 1:** Jesser winding up on an outdoor basketball court holding a massive vertical stack of taped basketballs.
  * **First spoken line:** *"This shot is worth 27 points..."*
  * **Movement:** Person jumps and releases the multi-ball shot toward the hoop.
  * **Text on screen:** "THIS SHOT IS" moving quickly to "WORTH 27 POINTS".

* **(3) VOICE**
  * **Pace:** Fast-paced, high-energy storytelling.
  * **Pauses:** Minimal, fast transitions between ideas.
  * **Emphasis:** Pitch and volume rise sharply on rival names ("Jesser", "Bodlefty") and rising point milestones ("33 point shot", "100 point shot", "1,000 points").

* **(4) SFX**
  * **Whoosh/Swish:** Accompanying ball releases and passes through hoops.
  * **Rapid ticking / score count sound:** Plays as balls trigger point counters going down stacked rims (~00:07–00:10 and ~00:24–00:26).

* **(5) MUSIC**
  * **Genre:** Fast-tempo upbeat electronic/hip-hop background track.
  * **Volume:** Mixed below the voiceover for clarity.
  * **Drop:** Maintains steady momentum, driving excitement into the final 1,000-point shot.

* **(6) VISUAL DEVICES**
  * **On-screen graphics:** Animated score counters overlaying stacked basketball hoops.
  * **Cuts:** Rapid editing, averaging 4–5 cuts per 10 seconds.
  * **Text overlay indicators:** "ATTEMPTS: 16" box during the final trick shot setup.

* **(7) LAST 2 SECONDS**
  * **What happens:** Jesser watches his custom ball cylinder pass through a massive vertical hoop tower, pushing the score counter past 1,000 points (1015).
  * **Loop:** Does not seamlessly loop back to the start frame.
